status: AI-generated assembled concept, not CAD, CFD, measured cooling or qualified installation. Generic geometry does not establish exact ports, shaft fit or exhaust routing.
inventory: One AM0701 motor confirmed by user. Jeanoko vortex tube assumed from earlier setup; current physical inventory not re-inspected.
topology: One scuba first stage and common shutoff/manifold, with separate secondary pressure-control and pulse-valve branches to motor and vortex tube. Motor shaft drives friction brake. Cold outlets remain separate. Vortex hot end vents away.
flow_equations: tank mass flow = motor mass flow + vortex inlet mass flow
vortex inlet mass flow = vortex cold mass flow + vortex hot mass flow
delivered cold mass flow = motor exhaust mass flow + vortex cold mass flow
limits: Do not connect near-atmospheric motor exhaust to the compressed-air vortex inlet.
Shared first stage, regulator paths and valves must sustain combined measured demand.
Separate outlet control avoids backpressure/crossflow between the branches.
Vortex flow basis/cold fraction and exact pressure rating remain unknown; do not transfer EXAIR ratings to Jeanoko.
Keep brake heat/dust and vortex hot exhaust away from cold probes and outlets.
Confirm exhaust collection, lubrication/oil carryover and cold limits before person-facing use.
